- **Docstring:** _This class implements an iterator object that can be used to loop
over an image sequence.

You can use the ``[]`` operator to access elements by index. This operator
will raise an :py:exc:`IndexError` if you try to access a nonexistent
frame.

#### `def all_frames(im, func)` (Línea 66)
- **Propósito:** Applies a given function to all frames in an image or a list of images.
The frames are returned as a list of separate images.

:param im: An image, or a list of images.
:param func: The function to apply to all of the image frames.
:returns: A list of images.
- **Firma:** `def all_frames(im, func)`
